name: Frame Window Analyzer
description: Records Geometry Dash inputs and analyzes HOLD/RELEASE frame windows for NaNDL-style frame-window calculations.

analysis-tps.name: Analysis TPS
analysis-tps.description: Fixed physics tick rate used while recording, playback and analysis.

scan-radius.name: Frame Scan Radius
scan-radius.description: How many frames before and after every HOLD/RELEASE are tested.

post-macro-validation.name: Post-macro Validation Frames
post-macro-validation.description: Extra frames a candidate must survive after the last recorded input.

auto-analyze.name: Analyze after recording
auto-analyze.description: Start frame-window analysis automatically when recording is stopped.

show-trajectory.name: Show trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Draw the actually simulated player path during record/playback/analyze.

analysis-speed.name: Analysis Speed
analysis-speed.description: Simulation speed multiplier used during automatic branch analysis.

exhaustive-scan.name: Exhaustive Scan
exhaustive-scan.description: Test all offsets even after a failed frame. Slower, but can reveal disjoint/non-contiguous passing islands.
